# MediaLocalize

> AI-powered website building and professional multilingual localization services for B2B manufacturers and exporters. English, Chinese, and 50+ languages — one specialist partner since 2009.

The site is available in 5 languages: English (root), Chinese (/zh/), Spanish (/es/), Russian (/ru/), and Arabic (/ar/, RTL). Every URL below has a counterpart in each language under those prefixes.

## Services

- [AI Website Building](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/website-building/): End-to-end AI-built websites for exporters — domain, design, on-page SEO, hosting, CDN, SSL, business email, AI customer service.
- [Multilingual Localization](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/localization/): Document, website, and software localization in 50+ languages.
- [DTP — InDesign & FrameMaker](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/localization/dtp/): Multilingual desktop publishing and pre-press QA.
- [AI & Human Voice Dubbing](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/localization/dubbing/): AI and human voice-over for corporate and marketing video.
- [E-Learning Localization](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/localization/elearning/): SCORM/xAPI course localization, Articulate Storyline workflows.
- [Video & Animation Localization](https://www.medialocalize.com/services/localization/video/): Subtitling, on-screen text replacement, voice-over.
